title: Online Yoga Platform
short_desc: A home yoga platform I built for my girlfriend: a video library with routines, plus a log to track progress over time.
blueprint_desc: Videos load quickly and play smoothly, routines are neatly organised, and every session is logged so progress is easy to follow — one place for both practice and training notes.
tech_notes: Designed to host and pipeline high-definition media playback layouts with minimal loading latency. Built with decoupled database backends to easily log video progression states alongside custom performance subroutines, providing an integrated space for organizing both mental consistency and training logs.
